buff_frozen.role: Stock frozen status shell for the boss.
buff_frozen.sourceGeometry: Mesh ice shell, ice floor, smoke, snowflakes and stars. No collider. Own orientation without following body scale.

buff_frozen_to_walk.role: Ground enemy freeze shell selected by buff_frozen_to_enemy motion mode 0.
buff_frozen_to_walk.sourceGeometry: Mesh ice shell, ice floor, smoke, snowflakes and stars. No collider. Own orientation without following body scale.

lethalTalent.heal: Immediate lifetime sbell2_t2[heal]. Its OnBuffFinish performs HealViaMaxHpRatio and emits sbell2_revive.

bindings.limitations: Default client status-to-prefab attachment is not serialized in the lethal buff graph. The stock status ice and exact ground-enemy branch are sampled individually. The board applies them to the owner and ground targets with projection and visible body anchor adaptations.
